scenes.narration: Here is the whole rule, on the live page. Read it from right to left. Rotate the board, add up the copies, and compare. Each click on step moves the board one generation.

scenes.narration: Rotate the board by minus one, zero, and one, along both axes. That gives nine shifted copies, one for each neighbor, and one for the cell itself.

scenes.narration: Add up the nine copies. Now every cell holds its own value, plus its eight neighbors.

sentences.text: Now every cell holds its own value, plus its eight neighbors.

scenes.narration: A cell lives on when the sum is three, or when it is alive and the sum is four.

scenes.narration: Run it. Start with just five cells, on a sixteen by sixteen board that wraps around. Press play, and watch it grow, one generation after another. Every step is that same single line.
